signature.name: VTask.extend
signature.type: {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_2} -> {γ : Sort u_3} -> (f : α → β) -> (g : α → γ) -> (j : β → γ) -> β → γ

conventions.statement: When ∃ a, f a = b, the result is g applied to a classically chosen preimage of b under f.
conventions.note: This is well-defined (independent of the choice) iff g.FactorsThrough f.

conventions.point: b not in range of f
conventions.statement: When no a satisfies f a = b, the result is j b.
conventions.note: j serves as a junk value; callers who only care about the image of f may pass 0 or Classical.arbitrary.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Sort*} [IsEmpty α] (f : α → β) (g : α → γ) (j : β → γ), VTask.extend f g j = j

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Sort*} {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : α → γ) (j : β → γ) (a : α), VTask.extend f g j (f a) = g a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Sort*} {f : α → β} {g : α → γ} (hfg : Function.FactorsThrough g f) (j : β → γ) (a : α), VTask.extend f g j (f a) = g a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Sort*} {f : α → β} {g : α → γ} (hfg : Function.FactorsThrough g f) (j : β → γ), VTask.extend f g j ∘ f = g

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {γ : Sort*} (g : ℕ → γ) (j : ℕ → γ) (n : ℕ), VTask.extend id g j n = g n

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α₁ α₂ α₃ γ : Sort*} {f₁₂ : α₁ → α₂} (h₁₂ : Function.Injective f₁₂) {f₂₃ : α₂ → α₃} (h₂₃ : Function.Injective f₂₃) (g : α₁ → γ) (e' : α₃ → γ), VTask.extend (f₂₃ ∘ f₁₂) g e' = VTask.extend f₂₃ (VTask.extend f₁₂ g (e' ∘ f₂₃)) e'

facts.statement: ∀ {β γ : Type*} {p : β → Prop} {g : {x // p x} → γ} {j : β → γ} {b : β} (hb : p b), VTask.extend Subtype.val g j b = g ⟨b, hb⟩

facts.statement: ∀ {β γ : Type*} {p : β → Prop} {g : {x // p x} → γ} {j : β → γ} {b : β} (hb : ¬p b), VTask.extend Subtype.val g j b = j b
